notes.title: Update to version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hola, amig@s!

In this small 1.0.2 update we squashed some bugs and improved menu handling in pause:

[list]
[*] BUG - minor - when jumping on dialog init with NPCs char can stuck in the ground blocking other actions
[*] BUG - trivial - jumping on dialogue start may not display the very first message
[*] BUG - medium - when rushing through the objects in powerup mode char can be killed by the objects
[*] UI - reduce navigation delay in the pause menu
[*] Extra - entering dialogue mode with NPCs is improved
[/list]

notes.title: Flippin Kaktus - Progress Update #1
notes.content:
[h3]Hi there![/h3]

In this weekly progress update we'd like to share with you the latest news of the game development.

[list]
[*] Added PostFX for the main menu;
[*] Set horizon levels for the birds to prevent flying on and under the ground;
[*] Added bounce effect for TNT/grenade;
[*] Added zoom in / zoom out camera mechanism.
[/list]

Few dialogue improvements:
[list]
[*] Dialogue mechanism - enabled widescreen stripes and initialization talk sequence;
[*] Added the mechanism for turning off the music volume during the dialogue, and turning it on after.
[*] Correction player's position when the dialogue starts in front of NPC;
[/list]

Thank you for staying, see you in the next update!

Yours,
Flippin Kaktus Dev. Team
